prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one new high-fidelity flat UI comparison board showing the existing Excalidraw mobile "编辑" property sheet inside DooKnow. Image1 is authoritative mobile property controls; image2 is style ONLY and must not contribute its desktop navigation. Two independent narrow local viewport specimens, A width390 and B width320, height844 each, side by side on neutral white outside whitespace. The whiteboard itself is empty, with rectangle TOOL selected but no drawn or selected object. Focus on the actual bounded bottom property sheet and existing bottom toolbar, not a full notebook/header shell. Each sheet is a white, fine-bordered8px-corner surface, internally scrollable if needed, with footer remaining reachable; use normal readable14px-equivalent type, not miniature all-page text. Display these groups in exact order: 描边 (five palette swatches dark/red/green/blue/orange plus current-color picker); 背景 (transparent checkerboard/pale red/pale green/pale blue/pale yellow plus picker); 描边宽度 (three line radios, middle checked); 边框样式 (solid/dashed/dotted radios, solid checked); 线条风格 (three roughness radios, middle checked); 边角 (sharp/round radios, round checked); 透明度 (slider current100 at right end, 0 left and100 right); 图层 (four existing icon buttons in order send-to-back, send-backward, bring-forward, bring-to-front). No fill-style group because background is transparent. Preserve source-group spacing and normal tap targets. Below the scrollable body keep the genuine bottom toolbar: left main-menu icon, active palette-shaped 编辑 toggle which also closes this sheet, disabled undo and redo icons at right. No additional X, Done/Save/Cancel, drag-handle or custom action footer; "选定形状操作" is an accessibility region name, not an added visible title. Do not draw text-specific or arrow-specific fields in this RECTANGLE specimen, no selected-element actions/duplicate/delete/link/crop/group, no font/arrowhead popup. Those conditional groups remain separate component variants. No invented shapes or user data. Use #ffffff paper, #f7f8fa soft controls, #272b3a text, #657084 secondary, #e6e9f1 border, #4566c6 active controls and #edf1ff selection tint. Preserve varied color palette swatches as actual drawing controls. Keep all content and Edit control inside narrow width; if body needs scroll show the real internal overflow boundary, never crop the footer or shrink every field. No gradients/textures/3D/device/browser chrome/developer notes.
